clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind City Hall, Baros Alexston keeps watch over the capital he helped rebuild. Once a close friend of Edwin VanCleef in the Stonemasons Guild, he stayed loyal to the crown when the guild fractured.

Baros grew up on the Alexston Farmstead in Westfall's rolling grasslands. Thieves overran and burned the family homestead while he was young. Before they fled, his father hurriedly hid their cherished heirlooms across the grounds. Baros later journeyed to the capital and joined the Stonemasons Guild. For years, he labored beside Guildmaster Edwin VanCleef as they raised Stormwind anew from the ashes of the First War.
